observations: Small-angle XRD: one low-angle reflection in all three patterns, at 2theta ~1.37 (MBG), ~1.47 (2Co) and ~1.35 deg (5Co)
TEM: parallel channel stripes over ~200 nm in a and a regular pore lattice in b, period ~5-6 nm
N2 isotherms of all three show a hysteresis step at P/P0 ~0.45-0.6 (type IV)
N2 uptake at P/P0 ~1 falls with Co: ~8.7 (0Co), ~5.6 (2Co), ~4.35 mmol/g (5Co)
Pore-size distribution peaks at ~5 nm for 0Co and 2Co (2Co lower) and at ~4.2 nm for 5Co

panels.caption_span: Fig. 2. Small-angle XRD analysis for MBG, 2Co-MBG and 5Co-MBG scaffolds.
